newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass Hut Sept same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass Hut Sept same store sales up.

text.p: Sunglass Hut International said Thursday that sales for the five weeks ended October 5, 1996, were $40.0 million, an increase of 34.3 percent above the $29.8 million reported for the same period last year. Comparable store sales for the five-week period increased 2.1 percent.

Year-to-date sales for the 35 weeks ended October 5, 1996, increased 31.8 percent to $373.4 million. This compares to sales of $283.4 million for the same period in 1995. Year-to-date comparable store sales increased 5.1 percent.
